items.title: Schneider Electric (ENXTPA:SU) Raises €6.0b As Investors Reassess The PTC Deal Valuation
items.summary: Schneider Electric (ENXTPA:SU) has just raised €6.0b through a multi tranche senior bond issue, a sizeable financing move tied directly to its planned acquisition of PTC Inc. and its recent €6.0b equity increase. For investors watching Schneider Electric, the recent financing arrives after a sharp reset in sentiment, with the share price down about 21% over the past month but still slightly positive year to date, while the 3 and 5 year total shareholder returns of 68.37% and 70.24% reflect...
